risk.rationale: No surviving verified findings exist for case-005. The two suspicious signals were both rejected by critics with reasoned explanations: (1) the inbox forwarding rule points to an internal @aegean.edu archive address created via OWA, which is not exfiltration; (2) the sign-in from 193.140.10.9 follows 71 failures across 68 accounts, but that same IP had 187 distinct accounts complete MFA in the last 30 days, indicating shared egress/background noise rather than a coordinated password spray. With no confirmed account takeover chain and no unexplained weak signal remaining, the suspicious signals are explained away.
